responsibility: This file implements H8/300 logical integer operations and related bit-manipulation idioms, covering AND, IOR, XOR, NOT, and several target-specific fused forms. It maps generic logical RTL to register, memory, and H8SX bitfield-capable instructions, provides optimization-time simplifications and peephole2 rewrites, and delegates complex opcode/length selection to helpers like output_logical_op and compute_logical_op_length when operand classes and mode-specific encodings determine the final H8 instruction sequence.
